districtFact: Puyallup School District is a Pierce County district of about 23,000 students across 54 square miles. Its student calendar combines a grades 1-12 opening followed by kindergarten, a recurring Monday one-hour late start, a local Fair Day with a 3.25-hour early dismissal, 2.5-hour early releases for conferences and school improvement, and ordered emergency make-up dates. Exact arrival and dismissal times vary by school.

about.title: About Puyallup School District
about.content: Founded in 1854, Puyallup School District serves approximately 23,000 students in Pierce County. The district reports a 54-square-mile boundary about 30 miles south of Seattle, with 22 elementary schools, seven junior high schools, three comprehensive high schools, an alternative high school, and online programs.

about.title: Monday Is a Different Bell Schedule
about.content: Most instructional Mondays on the school calendar begin one hour later than the Tuesday-Friday schedule. The district's bell page lists the actual hours school by school, so the one-hour label is the dependable districtwide rule while the clock time must be matched to the student's campus. A weather-related two-hour late start on Monday is measured from the ordinary Tuesday-Friday start, not added as two more hours after the regular Monday opening.

about.title: Fair Day Is Puyallup's Distinctive Calendar Date
about.content: PSD marks a September Fair Day as a 3.25-hour early dismissal for all grades. The calendar footer also says lunch is not served on Fair Day. This is a different schedule from the 2.5-hour conference, grading, and school-improvement releases, so families should not treat every shortened day as interchangeable.

about.title: Emergency Days Follow a Sequence
about.content: The PDFs identify reserve dates in order: two dates during the scheduled year, followed by days after the printed last day. A reserve date remains conditional until PSD announces that it will be used. In 2025-2026, February 13 became an attendance day to make up the December 17 closure, showing why families should follow revisions rather than relying only on an earlier download.

planningTips.title: Puyallup School District Calendar Notes
content: Match the first day to the student's grade. Grades 1-12 begin before kindergarten in both reviewed years.
Build the recurring Monday one-hour late start into transportation and childcare plans, then use the student's school bell schedule for the exact arrival time.
Keep the three shortened-day formats separate: one-hour Monday late starts, 2.5-hour early dismissals, and 3.25-hour early dismissals.
Plan lunch separately on Fair Day and the last student day. PSD's PDF says lunch is served on attendance days except those two dates.
Conference dates are shortened attendance days for all grades, not full closures.
Keep emergency make-up dates provisional. PSD uses the named in-year reserves before adding days after the scheduled last day.
Use the one-page PDF for the approved year structure and the live district calendar or school messages for later changes and campus events.

districtFaqs.q: Does Puyallup School District start late every Monday?
districtFaqs.a: Most Mondays when school is in session use a one-hour late start. Holidays, breaks, and no-school dates interrupt the pattern, so use the exact Monday list for the school year and confirm the campus bell time.

districtFaqs.q: Does kindergarten start on the same day as grades 1–12?
districtFaqs.a: No. Grades 1–12 start September 2, while kindergarten starts September 8.

districtFaqs.q: What is the Puyallup Fair Day schedule?
districtFaqs.a: Fair Day is a 3.25-hour early dismissal for all grades, and lunch is not served. Dismissal times vary by school.

districtFaqs.q: Are Puyallup conference days full days off?
districtFaqs.a: No. The fall and spring conference blocks are 2.5-hour early-dismissal days for all grades. Some dates divide the purpose between elementary conferences and secondary conference preparation, but all grades follow the shortened schedule.

districtFaqs.q: Can Puyallup's last day of school change?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. PSD publishes emergency make-up dates during the school year and after the scheduled last day. A reserve date becomes a school day only if PSD announces that it will be used.

districtFaqs.q: Is lunch served on Fair Day and the last day of school?
districtFaqs.a: No. PSD says lunch is not served on Fair Day or on the last day of school.
